DataCalcInsightTemplate.originalExpression: SELECT Individual__dlm.ssot__Id__c AS IndividualId__c, AVG(Individual__dlm.Purchase_Amount__c) AS AvgPurchaseAmount__c, COUNT(Individual__dlm.ssot__Id__c) AS PurchaseCount__c FROM ssot__Individual__dlm AS Individual__dlm GROUP BY Individual__dlm.ssot__Id__c
